scope: A re-import review container: paste markdown, plan via 016's planReimport, show the four counts, apply the matched updates through the note repository, mounted in the notes rail. Out of scope: creating unanchored notes from anchorless sections (016's recorded follow-up); the PDF bundle re-import.

acceptance_criteria.text: The counts equal planReimport's updates/unanchored/orphans/missing lengths.
A matched slug updates the author's existing note once (deduping identical content) or inserts one when absent; orphans and unanchored sections are not written.
The notes rail renders the control.

open_questions: RULE-25 (standing): the HTML comment is the only identity anchor; planReimport already enforces it. No second source is introduced.
RULE-15 (standing): a conflict keeps local text as a second note; this task sets content only on a matched anchor, so it does not merge or discard anything else.
Anchorless sections are reported, not applied; creating unanchored notes stays 016's recorded follow-up (raised, not silently dropped).
risks: A second identity source (heading/page) would break RULE-25; the hook only uses the slug map from planReimport.
Re-applying the same markdown must not duplicate: an existing author note is updated, and content that already matches is left untouched.
Applying notes writes through the outbox (RULE-08); it is a normal client write, not a server call.
